description: SHA-256 lock for released root migrations. A released migration may only change with an explicit `override` entry documenting why (see 0040).

override.reason: The canonical 0040 (as merged in PR #644) is structurally un-applyable to PostgreSQL: it references an undefined assert_immutable_except() function in a CREATE TRIGGER, declares composite foreign keys with no matching unique constraint on sage_workspace/sage_delivery_recipient, uses text columns for uuid foreign keys, and uses non-IMMUTABLE now() in an index predicate. Because it cannot be applied, it was never applied to any persistent environment (no CI/deploy step applies root migrations/*.sql; the sage tables are absent from the drizzle schema). The amendment repairs the unapplied canonical chain rather than creating environment drift.
override.evidence: Empirically confirmed by applying the canonical 0040 (git 097b7339f) to PostgreSQL (PGlite): it fails with 'there is no unique constraint matching given keys for referenced table "sage_workspace"'. No applier of root migrations/*.sql exists (platform-automation applies only migrations/platform/*.sql; drizzle-kit targets packages/db). See PR #645 audit.
